title: On a six-vertex arc, both far directions vanish only at diagonals below 1/2 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- On the length-9 width-2 arc `{0,1,2,3,4,5}`, the path entry from 1 to 2 has far-rim roots `-114917/19728` and `-114521/16560`. No off-diagonal pivot entry has a root in `(0, 5/8]`.
- The only positive common roots are diagonals. At `H_00 = 3821/116272` both directions of `(6,8)` vanish and the Schur bandwidth falls to 1. That diagonal is below `1/2`, so scaling it back to 1 makes the off-sum `58136/3821`.
- Selected κ is unchanged. This does not decide Gaussian boundary order.
